units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 25:23">Targ. Y. Gen. XXV, 23</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 60b">Git. 60ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל דא׳ גבר</he> whoever is in power wins (right of possession in cases in which the judge is unable to decide).
<cite ref="Chullin 39b:19">Ḥull. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>איניש אלמא</he> a powerful man (defying the law).—
Keth. 14ᵃ א׳ ליה בריא to him the positive assertion is the stronger argument.—Pl. אַלִּימֵי Ḥull. 76ᵃ thick (sinews).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:5">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>באגא דא׳</he> a village community of violent men.—Fem.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 44b:3">Kidd. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>מי א׳ כיד אביה</he> is she as strong, has she the same authority as her father has? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 34a:14">B. Mets. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>מי א׳ ממתניתן</he> is (the Boraitha) stronger (less pliable) than our Mishnah?—
<cite ref="Chullin 48b">Ḥull. 48ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A01868"><he>אַלִּימְתָּא</he></cite> the strong, thick (pin).—Pl. <cite ref="A01868"><he>אַלִּימָתָא</he></cite>.
